'''Jisk Barer''' was a [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]] fanatic that visited the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] to see the [[Boonta Eve Classic (32 BBY)/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]]. Barer sat in [[Watto/Legends|Watto's]] [[Watto's box|box]] next to [[Breedo]] and [[Bok Askol/Legends|Bok Askol]].<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|131|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: An Audience of Aliens}}</ref>

Barer had [[Color/Legends|orange]] skin and blue [[Eye/Legends|eye]]s. While at Watto's box, they wore tan colored [[Clothing/Legends|robes]].<ref name="TPM" /> Barer had a Quarren [[Gender/Legends|female]] first name that meant "fun-loving, playful." The fanatic had an archaic surname that meant "respected physician."<ref name="GalacticCampaign">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>
